headline: Nifty bounces as *IT and FMCG lead* the week
subline: Nifty 50 rose 0.44% this week with significant sector support.
hero_text: This week, IT and FMCG drove gains while metals lagged. Nifty rose 0.44%.

why.title: IT Sector Surge
why.desc: IT bolstered the market with strong gains.

why.title: FMCG Upswing
why.desc: FMCG stocks rallied, aiding the market.

why.title: Volatility Declines

bonus_text: IT and FMCG surged ahead, while metals struggled, widening the sector gap.

movers_note_losers: BSE and Reliance saw minor declines.

A fall in volatility often aligns with market rallies.
Contrasting FII and DII flows reflect differing market views.
